stem.text: A car of mass $1100\,\text{kg}$ is travelling at a constant speed of $15\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ up a slope inclined at $10^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. The combined frictional forces acting on the car are directed down the slope and are equal to $\dfrac{W}{5}$, where $W$ is the weight of the car.

stem.alt: Car on a slope inclined at 10 degrees to the horizontal, with an arrow labelled 15 m s-1 above the car.

stem.text: What is the useful output power of the car's engine?
